proposals.before: Governor-General Deng Tingzhen had already tightened enforcement of the ban and arrested opium offenders; the merchant Dent had already fled home.
proposals.after: Governor-General Deng Tingzhen had already tightened enforcement of the ban and arrested opium offenders; the merchant Jardine had already fled home.
proposals.reason: Chinese 查頓 is Jardine (William Jardine), not Dent (顛地); the idiomatic English misidentifies the merchant.

proposals.before: Serving under Imperial Commissioner Senggelinqin, he fought rebels at Jinghai, won four successive engagements, and pursued them to Xiaxihe. Vice Commander-in-Chief Tong Jian and Tianjin Magistrate Xie Zicheng were killed in action.
proposals.after: Serving under Imperial Commissioner Shengbao, he fought rebels at Jinghai, won four successive engagements, and pursued them to Xiaxihe. Vice Commander-in-Chief Tong Jian and Tianjin Magistrate Xie Zicheng were killed in action.
proposals.reason: Chinese 勝保 is Shengbao, not Senggelinqin (僧格林沁); the idiomatic English misidentifies the commissioner.

decisions.reason: s0044 has 洋商查頓; 查頓 is Jardine, while Dent is 顛地. The proposed idiomatic corrects only that misidentification.
s0206 has 欽差大臣勝保; 勝保 is Shengbao. Senggelinqin is 僧格林沁, a different person, so the proposed replacement is required.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 restores Jardine as the personal name for 查頓; the alternate-name Jardine claim existed only to compensate for the bad Dent personal-name and is no longer a distinct source-supported alias.
Accepted r0002 shows Senggelinqin was invented by the bad idiomatic of 勝保; Senggelinqin is 僧格林沁, not an alias of Shengbao, so this alternate-name claim has no source support.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 restores Jardine for 查頓; the English personal-name Dent came only from the bad idiomatic.
